jobs.description:
It's a good feeling to know you're doing your best with purpose every day. At Artivion, we manufacture high-quality products and solutions for the treatment of aortic diseases. Together with surgeons worldwide, we save lives. In doing so, we rely on the strengths of each and every employee. Your strength counts, too: As an important link in the chain, you make a contribution to saving lives together with us. Contribute your strengths and let us grow together.

We are hiring a

Training & Education Specialist (m/f/d) – Europe based

Your Strength

- Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biomedical Engineering, Nursing, Medical Technology, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience) 
- Experience as a Clinical Specialist, Training & Education Specialist, Product Specialist, or within the aortic repair/endovascular field 
- Experience delivering technical and clinical product training 
- Knowledge of endovascular therapies, anatomy, and pathology 
- Experience developing training materials, educational programs, and e-learning content 
- Familiarity with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and digital learning platforms 
- Excellent presentation, coaching, and facilitation skills 
- Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills 
- Customer-focused mindset with the ability to collaborate across international, cross-functional teams 

Your Contribution

- Develop, deliver, and continuously improve Training & Education programs across the EMEA region 
- Plan and conduct internal and external product training, certification, and onboarding activities 
- Create and maintain training materials, e-learning modules, and educational documentation 
- Manage assigned learning content and support the administration of the Learning Management System (LMS) 
- Coordinate onboarding, reinforcement, and recertification programs 
- Support customer workshops and educational events across EMEA 
- Manage training equipment and educational resources to ensure training readiness 
- Evaluate training effectiveness and drive continuous improvements 
- Collaborate closely with Product Management, Clinical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Marketing, and Sales 
- Act as the subject matter expert for assigned Training & Education programs 

Our Strength

- An international team with a strong focus on quality, innovation, and collaboration 
- A dynamic role with exposure to colleagues and customers across the EMEA region 
- Comprehensive onboarding and continuous professional development opportunities 
- The opportunity to shape and improve training programs that directly support customer success 
- A meaningful career with a clear mission: saving lives 

Contact

Apply now and join the Artivion team. We are looking forward to receiving your application documents in English directly via our online system.

Brian Russo, T: +41 435 08 39 01
JOTEC GmbH, a wholly owned subsidiary of Artivion, Inc.,
Lotzenäcker 23, 72379 Hechingen
www.artivion.com (http://www.artivion.com/)

Mission

As a Financial Controller/Accountant at AES you’re accountable for collecting, analyzing and reporting financial data. In the role you propose solutions, cost reductions and optimization of processes. Your profile requires in depth understanding of finance, tax and accounting principles (HGB and IFRS).

Accounting/Tax

- Manage accounting books and financial statements under HGB/IFRS with the support of the accountant
- Organize close and schedules, manage accruals and provisions
- Responsible for analytical accounting
- Prepare and organize the yearly audit with support of the accountant
- Ensure tax compliance, manage tax audits with the support of the accountant/tax advisor
- Prepare and analyze internal and external mandatory reports
- Back-up accountant for various tasks ensuring business continuity (i.e. payments execution)

Controlling/Reporting

- Develop financial and operating KPIs and ad-hoc financial analysis to drive better decision-making and monitoring
- Prepare reporting packages and dashboards to track performance (company/project/cost center) and compliance, including variance analysis and executive commentary
- Organize and consolidate budget and forecasts, including long term projections and cash forecasts, reviews data and proposes cost reductions
- Provide ad-hoc financial modelling, business case calculations, financial analysis and reporting

Process and Tools

- Draw up, develop and update the accounting and finance process and guidelines, propose process improvements
- Support internal controls and various audit activities
- Key user ERP and Business intelligence tool, maintenance of the general ledger

Profile

- Degree in economics with a specialization in Controlling/Accounting (or equivalent knowledge and skills acquired by other means)
- Several years (more than 7 years) of professional experience in accounting and controlling (analysis, budgeting and financial controls)
- Advanced Skills in ERP system (ProAlpha, SAP FI-CO or similar) and AI / business intelligence tools (Qlik) skills
- Microsoft Excel skills on an expert level (ability to develop Excel macros)
- Experience with working in an international environment
- Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate/present effectively with all levels of company personnel,
- Flexibility (willingness to take on new responsibilities and assignments as needed) and ability to work under pressure
- Careful, diligent, and detail-oriented approach to work
- Excellent German and English language skills (English working language)
- Strong organizational skills combined with a proactive mindset, reliability, and a results-driven approach

jobs.description:
Zertificon Solutions – Software Manufacturer since 2004.
We are IT security specialists: our products encrypt business communications. More than 25% of the 100 highest-revenue companies in Germany, as well as hundreds of medium-sized enterprises across all industries, already use our Z1 encryption solutions. We have big plans and continue to grow steadily. Nearly 120 employees are already working with us in Neukölln. Join our professional, highly qualified team: take on challenges, share your knowledge, learn new things, and discover your potential!

Test Automation Engineer (f/m/d) at an established IT-Security Company 

Join us as a Test Automation Engineer — ready to grow, get hands-on with real-world security software, and help make sure every release is as solid as it can be. You don’t have to know everything (yet) — but you should be curious, reliable, and not afraid to break things in the name of better quality. You'll be joining our Enterprise Team, which focuses on the needs of our large corporate clients - particularly when it comes to customized solutions and cryptographic applications. Help us to change our Z1 products to meet the needs of our enterprise customers.

Develop and test

- Design, develop, and execute automated software tests
- Analyze test results and debug issues found by automated tests
- Conduct manual tests when automated testing is deemed excessive

Collaborate and support

- Collaborate closely with developers to understand system requirements, functional specifications, strategies, and solutions
- Identify, report, and track defects, working closely with development teams to ensure timely resolution
- Support the team in analyzing bugs in CI/CD pipelines

Document and improve

- Generate test reports, metrics, and documentation to communicate test results and status to project stakeholders
- Stay updated on the latest trends, tools, and technologies in test automation and quality assurance

Your profile

- Proven experience as a Test Automation Engineer of at least 3 years
- Competent in Selenium and Java programming language
- Skilled in testing web and backend services effectively
- Knowledgeable in Agile software development methodologies
- Familiar in Git for version control
- Familiar with Linux and shell scripting
- Experience with Docker for containerization
- Familiar with Gradle build tools
- Excellent English language skills, at least C1 level

Nice to have:

- Familiarity with tools like TestRail, JIRA, Confluence
- Experience with cryptographic concepts and its basic principles
- Working with Smart Cards/Hardware Security Modules or Key Vault services
- Understanding of Email protocols and RFCs like SMTP, MIME, S/MIME, OpenPGP 
- Good German language skills

We offer:

- Flexible hours and home office options
- Mobility: free Germany-wide public transport ticket, bike leasing, or parking
- Subsidies for meals (e.g., delivery services) and home office internet
- Urban Sports Club membership for flexible fitness and wellness
- Office perks: rooftop terraces & green courtyard, organic fruit and drinks, personal packages accepted at the office
- Get-togethers monthly Pizza Friday, regular team events, big summer party
- Responsible leadership: structured onboarding, regular feedback, clear goals
- Innovative without startup risk: profitable for 20+ years, self-funded innovation with strong global potential
- International team: 120+ colleagues from 30+ countries, open and collaborative culture

If that resonates with you, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.occupation: Are you a skilled dentist from abroad?  (m/w/d) (Zahnarzt/-ärztin)
jobs.description:
Start Your Dental Career in Germany

We will support you on your journey to becoming a licensed dentist in Germany.

Have you graduated in dentistry outside Germany and dream of building your professional future here?

Are you looking for more than just a job? Do you want to become part of a friendly team that values you as a person and supports your professional development?

Then we would love to meet you.

About Us

We are a modern, family-owned dental practice located in the beautiful Northern Black Forest region of Germany.

Many of our patients have trusted us for years—often for generations. We know our patients personally, take time for them, and believe that excellent dentistry begins with trust and personal relationships.

We combine state-of-the-art technology with a warm and welcoming atmosphere.

Our practice offers:

- Digital dentistry
- CAD/CAM technology with same-day crowns
- High-quality prosthetic dentistry
- Modern diagnostics
- Professional preventive care
- A friendly and experienced team

We believe that exceptional quality requires time, dedication, and attention to every individual patient.

Your Career Path

We are looking for dentists from abroad who would like to complete their professional recognition and obtain their dental license in Germany.

You will begin working as a Dental Assistant while becoming familiar with the German healthcare system, our clinical procedures, and everyday practice.

During this time, we will actively support you throughout your recognition process until you achieve your goal of becoming a licensed dentist in Germany.

We already have experience successfully guiding an international dentist through this process and understand both the professional and personal challenges involved.

What We Offer

✔ Support during the professional recognition process

✔ A small and welcoming family-oriented team

✔ Modern equipment and digital workflows

✔ High-quality dentistry

✔ Excellent long-term career opportunities

✔ A respectful, supportive and appreciative working environment

An International Team

Moving to a new country can be challenging—but you won't be alone.

In our practice we speak:

🇩🇪 German

🇬🇧 English

Our team members also speak:

🇷🇺 Russian

🇺🇿 Uzbek

🇹🇷 Turkish

This multicultural environment helps many new colleagues feel comfortable from their very first day.

Live Where Others Spend Their Holidays

Our practice is located in one of Germany's most beautiful regions—the Northern Black Forest.

Here you'll enjoy:

- Beautiful forests and nature
- Excellent quality of life
- Safe and peaceful surroundings
- Easy access to Karlsruhe, Pforzheim and Stuttgart

Many international colleagues appreciate the relaxed lifestyle and welcoming community that our region offers.

Who We Are Looking For

You are a great fit if you:

- Graduated in Dentistry outside Germany
- Would like to build your future in Germany
- Minimum B1 German language level (better B2)
- Motivated to improve your German
- Enjoy working with people
- Are reliable, friendly and committed
- Appreciate teamwork and continuous learning

Let's Build Your Future Together

If you are looking for a practice that truly believes in your potential and wants to help you succeed, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Your journey to a successful dental career in Germany can begin here.

We look forward to getting to know you!

Full-time or part-time | Munich Alt-Bogenhausen

Phorms Campus Munich is a bilingual German-English education campus offering educational programmes from Crèche and Kindergarten through Primary School to Secondary School. Our well-located and lovingly maintained city campus in Munich Alt-Bogenhausen, close to the English Garden, is home to an international school community where children, families and staff feel welcome, supported and valued.

In our bilingual Kindergarten and Crèche, we encourage children to try out new things, respect themselves and others, develop empathy and curiosity, and grow in confidence and independence. In this way, we build a strong foundation for their future education.

For our Kindergarten and Crèche in Munich Alt-Bogenhausen, we are looking for a motivated and qualified Early Years Educator / English-speaking Kindergarten Teacher (all genders) in full-time or part-time.

English-Speaking Primary School Teacher

Your Tasks

Does shaping your career in a modern digital company where information security plays a central role sound exciting to you? Would you like to further optimize our security level for over 42 million customers and thus make an important contribution to global data and information security? Then you've come to the right place! As a Junior Security Professional in our Security Governance & Assurance team, which is responsible for the strategic aspects of information security at Mail & Media, you can grow into the following tasks:

- Designing and optimizing security-critical processes: You will optimize our internal security policies and guidelines as well as the BCM (Business Continuity Management) System, taking into account internal and external compliance requirements, state-of-the-art technical options, and the interests and structure of the company.
- Conducting security audits and assessments: You carry out audits and assessments in our internal departments as well as at business partners and suppliers, prepare the results in a target group-oriented manner, and support the closure of identified gaps.
- Increasing security awareness: You will contribute to a continuous increase in security awareness within the company by preparing and conducting training courses and presentations for various technical and non-technical target groups.
- Projects to improve the safety level: You will work on projects that increase the company's safety level.
- Preparation and representation in external audits: You will prepare necessary documentation and represent Mail & Media in external security audits, such as ISO27001.

Your Profile

Are you interested in information security and do you see yourself as an all-rounder and problem solver? Do you have a high affinity for technology and business? Are you open-minded, sociable, and enjoy working with people? Are you characterized by an analytical and structured way of working? Are you able to present complex problems and contexts in a way that is understandable for different target groups? Then we look forward to receiving your application! The following points will increase your chances:

- Degree and training: You have successfully completed or are about to complete a degree in (business) informatics or in a comparable area. You have specialized in information security and/or gained relevant practical experience, e.g., through internships.
- Technical basics and trends: You have sound theoretical technical knowledge and at the same time follow current trends such as AI, digitization, or DevSecOps. You enjoy gaining practical experience that helps you identify security risks in IT infrastructures and propose economic measures.
- Data affinity: You have a high affinity for data and data-driven decisions. Ideally, you have gained experience in the areas of data analysis, data visualization, data science, or process mining during your studies.
- Team player: You are a team player who leads by example at all times. Your commitment, empathy, and continuous willingness to learn will help you gain the necessary trust in the organization.
